# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Text — 4 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 13 tokens; Borders and rings — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 93 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 11 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Size — 7 tokens; Duration — 4 tokens; Easing — 2 tokens.

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--fg-default, #171b17);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--fg-default, #e4e7e2);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #171b17;
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--fg-default` | #171b17 | #e4e7e2 | Primary text and icons on bg-app, bg-surface, bg-raised, bg-sunken and bg-selected. |
| `--fg-muted` | #616760 | #aab0a8 | Secondary text, metadata, timestamps, code comments. Holds 4.5:1 on bg-app, bg-surface, bg-raised and bg-sunken. |
| `--fg-subtle` | #858b84 | #858b84 | Placeholders, disabled labels, decorative glyphs and axis ticks only (3:1). Never for text a person must read. |
| `--fg-inverse` | #f8faf7 | #171b17 | Text on bg-inverse. |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--bg-app, #f1f3ef);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--bg-app, #1f231f);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f1f3ef;
```

### Tokens (13)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg-app` | #f1f3ef | #1f231f | Page ground. The grey the whole product sits on: site body, app canvas, docs background. |
| `--bg-surface` | #fdfefc | #282d29 | Panels, cards, sidebars, table bodies, inputs. One step above bg-app. |
| `--bg-raised` | #fdfefc | #333833 | Menus, popovers, tooltips, dialogs. In dark it is one step lighter than bg-surface; in light it is separated by shadow-popover. |
| `--bg-sunken` | #e4e7e2 | #171b17 | Wells below the ground: code blocks, table headers, histogram track, inline code. |
| `--bg-selected` | #e7f7d0 | #0a2b1c | Selected log row, active nav item, picked field. Carries fg-default or accent-fg text. |
| `--bg-inverse` | #1f231f | #f1f3ef | Inverse chips and the marketing footer band. Text on it is fg-inverse. |
| `--on-accent` | #fdfefc | #0f1210 | Text and icons on accent and accent-hover. Dark text in the dark theme, where the fill is light moss. |
| `--accent-fg` | #155e3b | #b5e280 | Moss as text: links, active tab label, keyword in running text. On bg-app, bg-surface, bg-raised, bg-sunken, accent-subtle. |
| `--accent-subtle` | #e7f7d0 | #0a2b1c | Tinted ground behind accent-fg: badges, highlighted search matches, callouts. |
| `--accent-border` | #b5e280 | #155e3b | Hairline around accent-subtle areas. Decorative. |
| `--on-danger` | #fdfefc | #0f1210 | Text on danger-solid. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 72px/72px "Geist", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl); letter-spacing: -0.04em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/geist-latin-wght-normal.woff2`, `fonts/geist-latin-ext-wght-normal.woff2`, `fonts/geist-cyrillic-wght-normal.woff2`, `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2`, `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-ext-wght-normal.woff2` and `fonts/jetbrains-mono-cyrillic-wght-normal.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/geist-latin-wght-normal.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/geist-latin-wght-normal.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geist | `fonts/geist-latin-wght-normal.woff2` (weight 100 900) | `read fonts/geist-latin-wght-normal.woff2` | `var(--font-sans)` | `geist` |
| JetBrains Mono | `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2` (weight 100 800) | `read fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2` | `var(--font-mono)` | `jetbrains-mono` |

Every face: `fonts/geist-latin-wght-normal.woff2` (Geist, 100 900), `fonts/geist-latin-ext-wght-normal.woff2` (Geist, 100 900), `fonts/geist-cyrillic-wght-normal.woff2` (Geist, 100 900), `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2` (JetBrains Mono, 100 800), `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-ext-wght-normal.woff2` (JetBrains Mono, 100 800), `fonts/jetbrains-mono-cyrillic-wght-normal.woff2` (JetBrains Mono, 100 800).

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 1px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-px);
```

| `--space-2` | 8px | Control padding, gap between related controls, log row horizontal padding. |

## Duration

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--duration-fast: 100ms) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--duration-fast), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--duration-fast` | 100ms | Hover, press and tab changes. Anything a person triggers tens of times a day. |
| `--duration-base` | 160ms | Dropdowns, popovers, toggles, tooltips. |
| `--duration-slow` | 240ms | Dialogs, drawers, the one hero reveal. |
| `--duration-scramble` | 360ms | Upper bound of one ScrambleText run. |

## Easing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--ease-out), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ease-out` | cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) | Default for everything entering or responding to input. |
| `--ease-in-out` | cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) | Elements already on screen that move or resize. |
